modules.title: 一个草稿保存在哪里，换设备后会怎样
浏览器存储适合保存什么

items.title: 本地偏好和短期内容
items.text: 主题选择、未提交草稿和非敏感的界面偏好适合在浏览器留存，页面可以快速恢复用户刚才的工作。

items.title: 范围通常只到一个浏览器
items.text: 它不会自动同步给另一台设备，也不能让其他用户读取同一份数据；重要内容还要考虑清除数据、隐私模式和容量限制。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 浏览器存储不是服务端数据库，也不是存放密钥的保险箱。数据库支持服务端控制、多人共享和更可靠的持久化；发到浏览器的数据可能被该设备上的用户查看或清除。

lessonPractice.title: 团队要让用户在手机和电脑都看到同一份已提交订单。数据应主要放在哪里？

options.label: 放到受服务端控制的数据库，通过登录后的接口读取；浏览器存储只可辅助本地体验
options.feedback: 对。订单需要跨设备、可能也需要客服或其他系统读取，不能只依赖当前浏览器。

options.label: 只放 localStorage，因为刷新后还在
options.feedback: 刷新仍在不表示能跨设备同步，也不能提供服务端的权限与可靠保存。

options.label: 只放页面状态，用户不离开当前页就够了
options.feedback: 页面状态通常在刷新或关闭后消失，不能代表已提交订单。

en.title: A team needs users to see the same submitted orders on both phone and computer. Where should the data primarily live?

options.label: In a server-controlled database, read through authenticated APIs; browser storage can only assist the local experience
options.feedback: Correct. Orders must work across devices and may need support staff or other systems, so the current browser cannot be the sole source.

options.label: Only in localStorage because it survives a refresh
options.feedback: Surviving a refresh does not synchronize devices or provide server-side authorization and reliable persistence.

options.label: Only in page state because the user does not need to leave this page
options.feedback: Page state commonly disappears after refresh or close and cannot represent a submitted order.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把未提交的编辑草稿保存在浏览器存储中，并在刷新后恢复；正式提交的内容仍通过接口保存到数据库。不要在浏览器存储里放密钥或权限判断。改完后验证刷新恢复草稿和另一台设备读取已提交内容。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Save the unsubmitted editing draft in browser storage and restore it after refresh; keep submitted content in the database through the API. Do not put secrets or authorization decisions in browser storage. Verify draft recovery after refresh and submitted content from another device.

learning.assumes: You have seen a site remember a theme, draft, or previous filter.
learning.outcome: You can tell whether information only needs the current browser or must be stored by a backend and database for multiple devices or users.

modules.title: Where a draft lives and what happens on another device
What browser storage is suitable for

items.title: Local preferences and short-lived work
items.text: Theme selection, an unfinished draft, and non-sensitive interface preferences can remain in the browser so a page quickly restores recent work.

items.title: Its scope is usually one browser
items.text: It does not automatically sync to another device or make the data available to another user. Important information must also account for data clearing, private mode, and capacity limits.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Browser storage is neither a server database nor a vault for secrets. A database supports server control, shared access, and more dependable persistence; information sent to a browser may be viewed or cleared by the person using that device.

distinctions.label: Database
distinctions.text: {c:browser-storage} usually stays in one person's current browser. A {c:database} is managed by the backend and suits signed-in, shared, queryable, long-lived data.
